item.title: Revealed returns this April with WA’s largest celebration of Aboriginal art
item.description: In 2026, Revealed – Western Australia’s largest Aboriginal art market and exhibition – returns from April 18 to June 14, transforming the Perth Cultural Centre into a statewide celebration of First Nations art and culture. Now in its 18th year, Revealed is presented by the Aboriginal Art Centre Hub Western Australia (AACHWA) in partnership with…

item.title: Australian threatened species list grows to include rare WA wildflowers
item.description: Earlier this month, 36 plants and animals were added to Australia’s threatened species list, including four Western Australian species. The 36 includes five reptiles, one marsupial, one fish species, an insect, mollusc and 25 plants. Listed among the four WA species is the Queen of Sheba orchid, or Thelymitra variegata: a vibrant flower only found…

item.title: Revival House back in action for stacked lineup of cinematic gold on 16mm and 35mm
item.description: Good news for Perth film buffs: The Revival House at The Como Theatre is back in action from Wednesday 25 February following a short maintenance break. item.title: The WA drag racing legend building a 1,000mph rocket car to become the fastest man on Earth
item.description: Most people are starting to slow down in their 70s. Rosco McGlashan OAM is trying to go 1,000 miles per hour. Inside a workshop in Western Australia sits the Aussie Invader 5R — a bi-propellant rocket-powered land speed car designed to break the current world land speed record and push past the mythical 1,000mph barrier…
